title: Kasan farashin ku, kewayon kasuwa da ƙimar da kuke ƙirƙira
course_title: Dabarun Farashi & Ƙimar don Sabis da Aiki na Dijital

say: Kasan farashin ku, kewayon kasuwa, da ƙimar da kuke ƙirƙira.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 1 na Dabarun Farashi da Ƙimar.
Tare da sabis, babban farashin ku ba a iya gani: sa'o'in ku. Misali, Chiamaka da Bisi masu zane-zane ne a Enugu, masu irin wannan fasaha kuma kusan sa'o'i 80 da ake biya a wata.
Chiamaka na cajin tambarin naira 15,000, saboda abokin ciniki ya taɓa kiran abin al'ada. Kowane tambari yana ɗaukar sa'o'i 10, don haka tana samun Naira 1,500 kacal a kowace awa.

panel.kicker: Dalilin da ya sa muke rage farashi
panel.heading: Fasaha iri ɗaya, sa'o'i iri ɗaya, biyan kuɗi daban-daban

say: Bisi tana sayar da fakitin Starter kan naira 60,000. Yana ɗaukar awa 16, don haka tana samun naira 3,750 a awa ɗaya, da ƙarin naira 180,000 kowane wata.
Bambancin ba baiwa bane. Bisi farashin da gangan. Wannan adadin, kuɗin da aka karɓa ta duk sa'o'in da aikin ya ɗauka, shine ƙimar sa'a mai inganci.

panel.kicker: Dalilin da ya sa muke rage farashi
panel.heading: Fasaha iri ɗaya, sa'o'i iri ɗaya, biyan kuɗi daban-daban

say: Ƙasar farashi shine mafi ƙarancin farashi wanda har yanzu yana biyan bukatun ku na rayuwa, farashin kasuwancin ku da ƙaramin buffer. A ƙasa shi, kuna biyan abokin ciniki don yin aiki a gare su.

panel.heading: Inda kowane farashi ke zaune
items: Kasa mai tsada: mafi ƙarancin ku
Kasuwancin kasuwa: abin da masu saye ke tsammani
Rufin darajar: abin da ya dace ga abokin ciniki

say: Kewayon kasuwa shine abin da kwatankwacin masu samarwa ke caji don aikin kwatankwacin. Yana nuna abin da masu siye suka saba da shi, ba abin da dole ne ku yi caji ba.

say: Ƙimar darajar ita ce sakamakon da ya dace ga wannan abokin ciniki, kamar ƙarin tallace-tallace ko sa'o'i da aka ajiye.
Zaɓi farashi a saman benenku, mai hankali don kasuwar ku, kuma a fili ƙasa da ƙimar da abokin ciniki ke tsammani. Sa'an nan ku duka biyu nasara.

Kasuwancin kasuwa: abin da masu saye ke tsammani

say: Yanzu lissafta benen ku. Fara da maƙasudin kuɗi na wata-wata.
Zainab na bukatar Naira 220,000 a duk wata a matsayin albashi. Koyaushe sanya naku albashi a gaba.
Kudin kasuwancinta ya kai naira 90,000: data, man fetur na janareta, software, sufuri, da asusun maye gurbin kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka da wayarta.
Ta ƙara 15% buffer don tanadi, jinkirin watanni da haraji.
Naira dubu 356,500 ne ake sa ran a duk wata.
Awanni masu biyan kuɗi ne kawai ke samun kuɗi. Zainab tana aiki awanni 160 a wata, amma bin diddigin mako guda ya nuna kashi 55% ne kawai ake biya. Wato awa 88 kenan.
Naira 356,500 aka raba da sa’o’i 88, aka tattara, Naira 4,100 ne a kowace awa. Wato falonta.
Kunshin nata na yanzu shine posts 12 a wata, wanda ke ɗaukar kusan awanni 14.
Don haka farashin benensa sau 14 sau 4,100. Naira 57,400 kenan.
Naira 40,000 take karba. Naira 17,400 ne ga duk wani abokin ciniki da ya saya.
Lokacin da ba a biya ba, kamar ƙididdiga, admin da biyan kuɗi, aiki ne na gaske babu wanda ke biya kai tsaye. Don haka raba ta sa'o'i masu biyan kuɗi kawai.

panel.heading: Daga manufa zuwa farashin bene
panel.rule: Raba ta sa'o'i masu biyan kuɗi, ba duk sa'o'i ba. Zagaye sama, kada a kasa.

say: Tattara aƙalla rates biyar daga takwarorinsu, katunan kuɗin jama'a da dandamali.

Juya zuwa raka'a ɗaya, kamar kowane post
Tsara su kuma nemo ƙimar tsakiya

say: Lura abin da kowanne ya haɗa, saboda tayin mai arha ba tare da bita ba wani samfuri ne daban.

say: Maida kowace zuwa raka'a ɗaya. Biyar da Zainab ta bayar sun kai daga Naira 2,333 zuwa 5,000 a kan kowane mukami.

say: Matsakaicin darajar Naira 4,000 ne akan kowane mukami, don haka Naira 48,000 akan mukamai 12. Benenta na 57,400 yana kusa da saman, don haka dole ne ta nuna ƙarin ƙima, kamar rahotanni da amsa cikin sauri. Farashin mafi arha a cikin rukunin WhatsApp ba farashin kasuwa bane.

say: Ana batar da farashi idan ba a biya ku ba. Ana iya karya faɗakarwar biyan kuɗi da hotunan kariyar kwamfuta, don haka tabbatar da kuɗi a cikin app ɗin ku na banki.
Idan abokin ciniki ya biya fiye da haka kuma ya nemi maido da bambancin, jira har sai an daidaita cikakken adadin. Kuma babu abokin ciniki na gaskiya da ke buƙatar OTP, PIN ko lambar shiga.

panel.heading: Kafin ka isar da aiki
items: An tabbatar da ajiya a cikin app ɗin ku na banki
An yarda da iyaka a rubuce
Babu OTP ko PIN da aka raba
Sharuɗɗan biyan kuɗi na ƙarshe sun bayyana

say: Yanzu fitar da ingantaccen ƙimar ku na sa'a akan ayyukanku uku na ƙarshe, gina takardar bene mai tsada, da taswirar kasuwar ku.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Yi wannan tsarin
items: Nemo ƙimar ƙimar ku ta sa'a ta gaske
Gina takardar bene na farashin ku
